Maya (PM): Quick sync — Northbridge just asked for a private deploy pilot with burst capacity + HSM key support, target end of Q2. Need cross-team dep map and go/no-go by Apr 14.
Jon K: Do we have an initial list of technical must-haves? CPU/GPU shapes, model size, quantization, etc.
Maya (PM): They want a 7B model quantized to int8, dedicated pool, KMS-managed keys, and a short SLA for uptime. Console UX is low priority for them.
Lin (Runtime): Runtime slot: we need to validate 8-bit kernels and KV cache behavior. Estimate 3w for kernel validation + 1w for canary harness.
Aisha (Infra): Infra: on-prem network setup + VPC-peering + KMS access provisioning. Security review will take at least 2 sprints unless we defer HSM to phase 2.
Ryan (Security): HSM path triggers PRR and audit scoping. I can get a preliminary threat model and key rotation plan by next Wed, but full HSM integration needs vendor paperwork.
Jon K: If legal/Vendor blocks HSM, fallback is customer-managed KMS + Redwood-side isolation. We should document that in the SLA options.
Maya (PM): Timeline constraint: AE says the contract expects a pilot by 'end of Q2'. That's firm. So we need to trade scope vs schedule now.
Lin (Runtime): Proposal: MVP scope = model serving + basic telemetry + KMS integration (non-HSM). Phase 2 = HSM + console features + latency SLA tuning. This reduces risk.
Jon K: Agree. Also propose an explicit fallback policy: if private capacity is saturated, route non-critical traffic to hosted variant. Keeps customer apps alive.
Lin (Runtime): Fallback sample config (for the handoff doc):
```
{ "route": "prefer-private", "fallback": "redwood-hosted/v1", "max_burst_per_tenant": 50 }
```
Aisha (Infra): Need to confirm storage encryption and audit log retention with legal. If customer requires 1y retention, that adds infra work.
Ryan (Security): Checklist I will own: PRR, threat model, HSM vendor questionnaire (if used), key rotation cadence, audit log plan.
Maya (PM): Actions: Jon -> draft scope doc with MUST/SHOULD/WON'T by Tue; Lin -> runtime risk matrix + fallback plan by Tue; Aisha -> infra cost/estimate + network checklist by Wed; Ryan -> security checklist and PRR kickoff by Wed. I'll ping AE/legal after docs land.
Jon K: ack
Lin (Runtime): ack
Aisha (Infra): ack
Ryan (Security): ack
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4921 and PRR request INF-4922; linked to this thread.
Maya (PM): Thanks — let's keep this tight. If any blocker surfaces, tag me and I'll escalate with AE.
